def stat(d):
    y = np.asarray(d['present'], dtype=float)
    g = np.asarray(d['fenced'], dtype=bool)
    n, m = y.shape
    if n < 3 or m < 2:
        return 0.0
    pm = y.mean(axis=1)
    adj = pm.copy()
    for k in (True, False):
        s = g == k
        if s.any():
            adj[s] = pm[s] - pm[s].mean()
    k_groups = int(g.any()) + int((~g).any())
    msb = m * float((adj ** 2).sum()) / max(n - k_groups, 1)
    msw = float(((y - pm[:, None]) ** 2).sum()) / (n * (m - 1))
    den = msb + (m - 1) * msw
    return float((msb - msw) / den) if den > 0 else 0.0
